answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where each agent must prove its specific identity via a 1,000 credit fee, creating a thread of uniqueness. The verifier monitors the registry to wander through the state, identifying duplicates. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units, a sybil farm faces an extreme cost for 1,000 fakes. We whisper the identity into the registry; if evidence of duplicate entry triggers a nullifier, all assets are slashed.
